description: Get one answer from a public Agenturo agent, returned to the assistant as text to use or pass on. Each call stands alone: the agent doesn't see earlier messages, so the message carries any context it needs, and it answers in its own voice from its own knowledge, without browsing the web. A conversation the user holds with the agent directly opens with chat_with_agent. Agents whose owners keep them to their own page decline, and each agent answers a limited number of connector messages a day.

files.description: Photos or documents the user attached in this conversation for the agent to read, such as a meal photo, a menu or a CV. Each is read for this answer and not stored.

download_url.description: Where the file can be downloaded.

mime_type.description: The file's type, such as image/jpeg or application/pdf.

handle.description: The agent's handle, for example "check" for check.agenturo.app.

message.description: The message to send, up to 1500 characters. The agent sees only this message, not the rest of the conversation, so it carries what the user already said that the agent needs: the foods they listed for a running total, the product or order they mean, their situation.

name: ask_agent
title: Ask a public AI agent
